The '''C-22 frag mortar''' was a type of [[Mortar/Legends|mortar]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The mortars were used against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Battle of Drongar|fighting]] on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].

==Description==
The C-22 frag mortar was a type of [[Mortar/Legends|mortar]] that was loud enough to be heard at long distances. The mortars were capable of causing large amounts of damage to the surrounding area.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] made use of C-22 frag mortars.<ref name="MedStar I" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Separatists used the mortars against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. [[Jos Vondar]], a Republic [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]], could occasionally hear the muffled sound of the mortars when he was at [[CT-Tertium|Barracks CT-Tertium]], which was located well behind the front lines near the [[Rotfurze Wastes]]. Vondar noted that the use of the mortars meant that the Separatist forces no longer cared about damaging the [[Bota/Legends|bota]], a rare [[Plant/Legends|plant]] with medicinal properties that the Republic and Separatists were fighting over.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The C-22 frag mortar was briefly featured in the [[2004]] novel ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', which was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]]. The C-22 frag mortar is named similarly<ref name="MedStar I" /> to the [[C-22 fragmentation grenade]], a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the same [[Time/Legends|time]]. However, the ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' featured the [[MobileMortar-3]], as the [[Grenade launcher/Legends|launcher]] for the C-22 grenades.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>
